obligations.claim: Orientation coherence conditions admissible knot-class selection (T) but is not independently sufficient for closure stability.

must_establish.formal_need: Define C_orient in a way that does not presuppose closure topology.

non_circularity_constraint.statement: C_orient must be computable before topology class, knot class, or closure stability is evaluated.

validation_tests.name: Input Isolation Test
validation_tests.question: Can C_orient be computed before any closure topology is classified?
validation_tests.method: Run C_orient calculation pipeline on chi_D and admissible orientation assignments only; confirm output does not require a prior T_class or closure step.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient output exists using only chi_D and admissible orientation assignments.
validation_tests.fail_condition: Pipeline errors or returns null without topology input.

validation_tests.name: Topology Blindness Test
validation_tests.question: Does C_orient remain unchanged when topology labels are withheld or permuted?
validation_tests.method: Compute C_orient twice: once with T_class labels present in environment, once with T_class labels removed or randomly permuted. Compare outputs.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient values are invariant under removal/permutation of T_class labels.
validation_tests.fail_condition: C_orient values differ when T_class labels change.

validation_tests.name: Closure Stability Blindness Test
validation_tests.question: Does C_orient avoid dependence on S_closure?
validation_tests.method: Compute C_orient with and without S_closure outputs in environment. Compare.
validation_tests.pass_condition: C_orient values are invariant under withholding S_closure outputs.
validation_tests.fail_condition: C_orient values differ when S_closure is withheld.

validation_tests.name: Orientation Shuffling Sensitivity Test
validation_tests.question: Does shuffling orientation assignments lower or decorrelate C_orient under matched chi_D?
validation_tests.method: Run matched pairs: (a) coherent orientation assignment, (b) shuffled orientation assignment over same chi_D. Compare C_orient distributions.
validation_tests.pass_condition: Shuffled orientation regimes produce lower or decorrelated C_orient than coherent regimes.
validation_tests.fail_condition: Shuffled and coherent regimes produce indistinguishable C_orient values.

must_establish.formal_need: Define a topological metric (e.g., braid index) to categorize observed closures.
must_establish.candidate_form: T_class_metric(G_K) := [T_k, b(T_k), inv(G_K)] where G_K := graph(K_obs)

non_circularity_constraint.statement: T_class_metric must classify topology without C_orient input.

ontology_ruling.statement: T_class_metric classifies topological organizations generated by continuation under constraint, not bare graphs or braid index projections directly.

must_establish.requirement: Stability arises from Principle 2.X, not orientation.

Verify that specific knot-classes T_k only emerge in compatible orientation regimes.

null.statement: Orientation coherence has no independent effect on knot-class selection or admissible topology T.

alternative.statement: Orientation coherence narrows the set of admissible knot-classes T.

required_form.support_condition: Orientation coherence significantly shifts the modal T_class.
required_form.failure_condition: T_class distribution is invariant to orientation structure.

support.condition: Orientation coherence significantly and predictably narrows the distribution of knot-classes.

downgrade.condition: Orientation effect on T is weak or easily overridden by high residue pressure.

falsify.condition: Topological selection is independent of orientation coherence.

if_supported: OPEN_BRIDGE_001 may be promoted to SUPPORTED.
Triadic closure TC_asym may exit REVIEW_LOCK into T-class specific promotion.
if_falsified: Orientation is retired as a structural selector.
Knot-class selection must be rerouted to pure residue-admissibility dynamics.
